name: Takaishi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takaishi city emblem in navy: a disc bearing a white stylised character with a cross and a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Takaishi, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 December 1966.

features.role: Takaishi city emblem — a disc bearing a white stylised character with a cross and a ring
